smart.label: Ask the Game AI UI
smart.description: Master toggle for Ask the Game AI interactive assistant drawer and buttons.

smart.label: AI Tuning Lab UI
smart.description: Master toggle for the AI Tuning Lab screen. Off by default.

smart.label: Guardian AI Safety Assistant
smart.description: Master toggle for Guardian AI mistake prevention and safety warnings.

smart.label: The Long Rivalry (Campaign)
smart.description: An eight-chapter campaign against one rival who remembers every chapter. Adds New Campaign and Continue Campaign to the main menu.

smart.label: Autosave & Resume
smart.description: Keeps a recovery copy of the match in this browser at each turn and offers Resume match on the main menu.

smart.label: Match Journal & Daily Seed
smart.description: Remembers finished matches on this device (results, personal bests, scenario ticks), adds Rematch to the end screen, lets you replay a seed and offers a daily seed.

smart.label: Turn Digest
smart.description: One "Since your last turn" card summarising what the rival did and what changed, instead of a pile of toasts.

smart.label: Rival turn pace
smart.description: How quickly the rival's turn is shown. Normal is the original timing; Fast shortens the pauses; Instant skips them. Never changes what the rival does.

smart.label: Classic sticky toasts
smart.description: On = routine notifications stay on screen until dismissed, as before V9.9.

smart.label: Classic play-screen layout
smart.description: On = the floating turn pill and floating quick-actions bar as before V9.9.

smart.label: Warn before closing the tab mid-match
smart.description: The browser asks before a reload or a closed tab throws away what you played since the last save. It stays quiet while Autosave & Resume holds a current copy.

smart.label: Rival Races
smart.description: Every few days a public race opens — first to win a challenge in a named state, take control of a region, set foot somewhere new, win a run of challenges or earn a sum. The winner takes the prize, and the rival races too. AI Opponent mode.

smart.label: Classic rival (V9.9)
smart.description: On = the rival plays as it did in V9.9: it often picks one of its lesser moves at random, a mistake costs it a whole action, and it gets no win-streak bonus. Matches started before V10.0 always keep that rival.

smart.label: Rival Recap
smart.description: After the rival's turn a card lists what it did and why, in plain words, with the cash each move made or lost. Nothing about how the rival plays changes.

smart.label: Daily Challenge (fixed rules)
smart.description: Today's Daily Seed match always runs on the same character, length, win goal and rival, so "best today" compares like with like. Needs the Match Journal.

smart.label: Classic rules (V10.0)
smart.description: On = a new match plays by the V10.0 rules: the Resource Market, challenge payouts, the rival's costs and mid-match rule changes work as they did in V10.0. Matches started before V10.1 always keep their rules, and a match in progress keeps the rules it started with whatever you set here.

smart.label: Find Anything
smart.description: One search box for every action, screen, setting, keyboard shortcut and LAB card (the 🔎 Find button and Ctrl/⌘+K). Nothing about how a match plays changes.

smart.label: Essentials and goal groups
smart.description: Settings opens on Essentials, the 12 choices most players want, with everything else filed under five goals instead of 11 tabs. Every setting keeps its key, default and value. Nothing about how a match plays changes.

smart.label: What's in the game
smart.description: One page with a card for every optional feature: what it does, whether it is on, its switch and what it needs. A switch on a card is the same switch as in Settings. Nothing about how a match plays changes.

smart.label: Side panel
smart.description: Market, Challenges, Travel, Workshop and Investments open as tabs in one panel beside the map instead of windows over it, on screens at least 1024 px wide. Nothing about how a match plays changes.

smart.label: Classic layout (V10.1)
smart.description: On = the game looks and works as V10.1 did: no Find Anything, Settings opens on the Simple view and its 11 tabs, no What's in the game page and no side panel. Those four switches keep your choices and bring them back when you turn this off. Nothing about how a match plays changes.

smart.label: Canonical Action Routing (V9.7)
smart.description: Infrastructure, expedition and crisis actions reach their full handlers (project starts, expedition targets, crisis chains). Off keeps V9.6 routing, so V9.6 replays reproduce exactly.

smart.label: Guided First Match
smart.description: On first launch, start a guided match (one goal, three actions, new tools unlocked one at a time). Switched off after finishing or skipping; switching it off yourself is permanent for this browser.

smart.label: Match Shape
smart.description: Secret objectives (2 per actor, worth points at the end), a scaled underdog boost for the trailing side, and a Final Stretch with high-stakes challenges and a national event.

smart.label: Objective Weight
smart.description: How many objective units each completed secret objective adds to the final win-metric score (0–3).

smart.label: Comeback Strength
smart.description: Multiplier on the underdog boost (cheaper travel, a free challenge reroll per turn, lighter loan interest). 0 turns it off.

smart.label: Comeback Full-Strength Gap
smart.description: Relative gap on the win metric at which the underdog boost reaches full strength; smaller gaps get a proportional boost.

smart.label: Final Stretch Length
smart.description: The Final Stretch covers this percentage of the match at the end (5–50%).

smart.label: Opponent Personality
smart.description: The rival speaks from its memory (grievances, trust, rivalry, gratitude, plans) and shows its mind in an Opponent panel; taunts, offers and threats use the same voice.

smart.label: Visual Mode
smart.description: Enhanced shows the SVG map of Australia, animated tokens and game-feel effects; Classic restores the V9.5 look.

smart.label: Sound Effects
smart.description: Synthesised sound effects for challenges, cash, travel, turns and events.

smart.label: Sound Volume
smart.description: Master volume for sound effects (0–1).

smart.label: Reduced Motion
smart.description: System follows your OS setting; On removes animations; Off keeps them.

smart.label: Expanded Challenge Content
smart.description: 128 more hand-written challenges across the eight regions, shown on a rotating 4-slot board you can scout.

smart.label: Procedural Challenges
smart.description: Deterministic template-generated challenges fill a region's board once its hand-written ones are used up.

smart.label: Challenge Approaches
smart.description: Every challenge offers 2–3 approaches with their own stat, odds, reward, failure cost and side effects; adds regional reputation and challenge chains.

smart.label: Experience Mode
smart.description: Explorer hides the national-economy systems and skips their processing; Nation foregrounds them; Full is the classic V9.5 arrangement.

smart.label: Guardian Protection Level
smart.description: Sensitivity level for Guardian AI risk detection.

smart.label: Guardian Response Mode
smart.description: Mode of response when risks are detected by Guardian AI.

smart.label: AI Planning Depth
smart.description: Depth of forward planning steps for AI decision making.

smart.label: AI Thinking Depth Tier
smart.description: Thinking depth speed/quality tier (fast, balanced, deep).

smart.label: Team AI Tactical Lookahead Depth
smart.description: Lookahead horizon for team AI tactical planning.

smart.label: Team AI Candidate Evaluation Width
smart.description: Number of candidate actions evaluated per turn by team AI.

smart.label: Team AI Maximum Plan Duration (Days)
smart.description: Maximum duration in days for committed team AI plans.

smart.label: Projected Outcome Horizon
smart.description: Lookahead horizon (in turns) for match win projection calculation.

smart.label: Strategic Command Directive Duration (Days)
smart.description: Duration in days before short-term Overseer directives expire.

smart.label: Friendly Team AI Algorithm
smart.description: Primary decision engine algorithm used for friendly team AI actors.

smart.label: Enemy Team AI Algorithm
smart.description: Primary decision engine algorithm used for enemy team AI actors.

smart.label: Opponent AI Algorithm
smart.description: Primary decision engine algorithm used for rival/opponent AI actors.

smart.label: AI Strategy Lab Preset
smart.description: Preset evaluation factor profile for AI decision tuning.

smart.label: Team Mode AI Systems Master Switch
smart.description: Enables specialized team-mode AI algorithms and coordination.

smart.label: Team Brain Teammate Support Bias
smart.description: Weight modifier for actions that assist/support team members.

smart.label: Parallel Planning Coordination Strictness
smart.description: Strictness level for multi-actor parallel plan conflict resolution.

smart.label: Team AI Resource Reservation Strictness
smart.description: Strictness of resource reservations among teammates.

smart.label: Team AI Strategic Command System
smart.description: Enables top-down team directive generation and strategic oversight.

smart.label: Strategic Command Authority Mode
smart.description: Authority mode for Overseer directives (off, advisory, authoritative, strict).

smart.label: Strategic Command Directive Score Bias
smart.description: Additive score bonus applied to actions matching active directives.

smart.label: Team Economy Governor Master Switch
smart.description: Enables team cash floor protection and emergency spending approval.

smart.label: Economy Reserve Strength
smart.description: Target cash reserve buffer strictness (low, balanced, high, maximum).

smart.label: Economy Spending Approval Strictness
smart.description: Strictness of economic governor checks on large purchases.

smart.label: Auto Mode (Adaptive Match Manager) Master Switch
smart.description: Enables live match adaptation and dynamic setting recommendations.

smart.label: Auto Mode Permission Mode
smart.description: Permission tier for Auto Mode adjustments (read_only, recommendation_only, assisted, autonomous).

smart.label: Auto Mode Allow Strategy Changes
smart.description: Allows Auto Mode to adjust AI strategy and decision weights.

smart.label: Auto Mode Allow Economy Changes
smart.description: Allows Auto Mode to adjust economic thresholds and loan parameters.

smart.label: Auto Mode Allow Action Management Changes
smart.description: Allows Auto Mode to adjust action limits and turn execution parameters.

smart.label: Auto Mode Allow Numerical Handicaps
smart.description: Allows Auto Mode to grant raw cash or stat handicaps (affects fairness).

smart.label: AI Fairness Level Multiplier
smart.description: Multiplier for AI decision efficiency vs raw numerical handicaps (1.0 = equal). V10.1 (SECTION 20BC): in a one-on-one match it only rescales how the rival rates its own moves; it does not change the rival's income, costs or odds.

smart.label: Randomness Mode
smart.description: Controls match randomness style (predictable, balanced, unpredictable, chaotic).

smart.label: World RNG Mode
smart.description: How a match gets its world seed: "random" starts every match on a new seed, "deterministic" replays the configured World Seed. Both are fully seeded.

smart.label: AI Deterministic PRNG
smart.description: Gates AI decision PRNG to a fixed seed for reproducible simulation.

smart.label: Global Deterministic RNG Active
smart.description: Global master switch for match-wide deterministic RNG seed pipeline.

smart.label: Total Match Days
smart.description: Maximum number of calendar days in a standard match.

smart.label: Player Actions Per Day
smart.description: Number of action points allocated to human players each day.

smart.label: AI Actions Per Day
smart.description: Number of action points allocated to AI players each day.

smart.label: Max Actions Per Turn
smart.description: Maximum action points allowed per turn sub-step.

smart.label: Action Limits Enabled
smart.description: Enables daily/turn action point caps and enforcement.

smart.label: Human Player Automation & Action Rules
smart.description: Enables custom human macros, automated triggers, and script rules.

smart.label: Team Governance Mode
smart.description: Team decision-making model (democratic, autocratic, consensus, meritocratic).

smart.label: Governance Live Control Surface
smart.description: Enables live voting, law proposal surfaces, and veto controls.

smart.label: Governance Leader Vote Weight
smart.description: Vote weight multiplier for team leaders in democratic/consensus votes.

smart.label: AI Match Replay Recording
smart.description: Records versioned, checksummed replay streams for post-match inspection.

smart.label: Preserve Replay Determinism
smart.description: Ensures live adjustments do not invalidate replay seed checksums.

smart.label: Replay Comparison & Diffing
smart.description: Enables side-by-side replay stream comparison and divergence tracking.

smart.label: AI Market & Economy Impact
smart.description: Allows AI transactions to affect global supply/demand market prices. V10.1 (SECTION 20BC): in team modes it also gives Hard AI actors $250 and Expert AI actors $500 extra starting cash, small yield and cost bonuses by difficulty, and any extra actions you configured; the one-on-one rival only moves prices.

smart.label: AI Economy Interaction Weight
smart.description: Weight modifier for AI market and investment decisions.

smart.label: Economy Cash Floor
smart.description: Minimum emergency cash threshold before AI enters debt recovery.

smart.label: Advanced Loans System
smart.description: Enables credit scores, interest accrual, refinancing, and loan tiers.

smart.label: Expeditions & Ancient Relics
smart.description: Enables regional expedition mapping, relic items, and relic equipment.

smart.label: External Expedition Travel Mode
smart.description: Enables offshore territory expeditions and transit journeys.

smart.label: Regional Contracts System
smart.description: Enables regional contracts board, delivery quotas, and bounty payouts.

smart.label: AI Regional Contract Priority Weight
smart.description: Priority multiplier for AI actors bidding on or fulfilling contracts.

smart.label: State Infrastructure System
smart.description: Enables state infrastructure investment projects and regional bonuses.

smart.label: AI Infrastructure Investment Priority
smart.description: Priority multiplier for AI actors funding infrastructure projects.

smart.label: Fog of War
smart.description: Hides unvisited region details, opponent inventories, and hidden actions from you. V10.1 (SECTION 20BC): the one-on-one rival still reads your cash and net worth when it chooses its moves.

smart.label: AI Decision Transparency Overlay
smart.description: Displays real-time AI reasoning cards and score factor breakdowns.

smart.label: Decision Transparency Scope
smart.description: Scope of AI decision traces shown to player (all, player_only, team_only).

smart.label: Decision Transparency Detail Level
smart.description: Detail level tier for decision transparency cards (1=simple, 2=detailed, 3=full).

smart.label: Decision Explanation Depth
smart.description: Depth tier of natural language rationale explanations.

smart.label: Activity Ledger Detail Level
smart.description: Detail tier for match Activity Ledger event payloads (standard, detailed, developer).

expModes.label: Explorer
expModes.tagline: Travel, challenges and rivalry. Nothing else on screen.
expModes.description: Cross Australia region by region: take on challenges, trade, craft, borrow and outscore the rival AI alone or in a team (the equipment shop, sabotage and diplomacy are optional switches in Settings, off until you turn them on). The national economy simulation (industries, supply chains, infrastructure networks, megaprojects, public finance, households and the rest) stays completely out of your way — no panels, no inspectors, no national notifications, and no per-turn processing. Recommended for a first match.
includes: Crafting and loans (shop, sabotage and diplomacy: optional, in Settings)

expModes.label: Nation
expModes.tagline: Run the country. Challenges become a means to an end.
expModes.description: Keep every challenge, trade and rivalry mechanic, but put the national systems first: freight, energy, water and digital networks, industries and supply chains, megaprojects, innovation, resilience, national priorities, regional competition, workforce, governance, public finance and households. The HUD, your current objective and the event feed foreground national conditions.
includes: All national systems (industries, supply chains, infrastructure, public finance...)
National strips above the decision card
National objective and event feed first

expModes.label: Full
expModes.tagline: Everything, in the classic V9 arrangement.
expModes.description: The complete game exactly as it played before experience modes existed: every explorer and national system on, V9 ordering of the HUD and panels, and all thirteen national toggles available in the settings hub. Saves made before V9.6 load into this mode so nothing they were simulating is lost.
includes: Classic V9.5 HUD and panel order
